thread:
maria: pushed an update to PR #4986 — addressed the review comments (removed the extra memcpy, moved the allocator change behind a flag, added unit+integration tests). PTAL when you have a sec. targeting canary tomorrow morning
ash: taking a look now, thanks. did you keep the old allocator path behind the flag so we can roll back quickly?
maria: yep, kept the old path and added a feature flag defaulted to off. added a note in the PR description about rollback steps.
sam: quick q — does the new path change any public metrics? need to update dashboards if so
maria: no new metrics, only internal counters for debugging. I left a comment in the code where we'd hook a metric if we decide to expose one later
jen: ran the unit tests locally. failing flake in TestAllocatorRace, looks timing-related — can you add a tiny sleep in the test harness? not ideal but fast to get green
maria: good catch, added a retry+short sleep in the test (commented why). re-ran locally, all green for me
ash: code lgtm from me, left one tiny wording nit on the PR description (suggest clarifying rollback steps).
maria: nit fixed, pushed. also added a short checklist in the PR body: QA smoke, canary window, rollback steps
ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green (unit, integration, lint). merge blocked by 1 more approval.
jen: i can give an approval after the smoke run, planning to kick one off now. ping me when canary slot is scheduled :thumbsup:
maria: thanks! scheduling canary for 09:00 UTC tomorrow. smoke script is in the PR description under "smoke steps". PTAL again for final ok so we can merge before the canary
sam: ptal, smoke steps look sane. i'll monitor latency for the first 15m during canary
jen: approved. :shipit:
maria: thanks all, will merge once the merge window opens and I'll post a follow-up if anything odd shows up during canary
ash: thanks for handling the follow-ups, looks good to me too :thumbsup:
ci-bot: merged by maria at 2487657900 — CI post-merge checks running.
